papers.title: AlCoCuFeNi high-entropy alloy with tailored microstructure and outstanding compressive properties fabricated via selective laser melting with heat treatment
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory for Advanced Metals and Materials, University of Science and Technology, Beijing 10083, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Xianglin Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory for Advanced Metals and Materials, University of Science and Technology, Beijing 10083, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Yaoyao Fiona Zhao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, McGill University, Montreal, QC, Canada H2A0C3

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向无关，未涉及生物医学植入物或多孔结构。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure for stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光熔化制备高熵合金的微观结构与力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化和后续热处理调控微观组织。
summary_zh.result: 获得了优异的压缩性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试和微观表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and mechanical properties of a high-entropy alloy fabricated by selective laser melting and heat treatment.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting followed by heat treatment was used to tailor the microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural characterization were performed.

papers.title: Ninety-Day Costs, Reoperations, and Readmissions for Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty Patients of Varying Body Mass Index Levels
papers.first_author_affiliation: Division of Orthopaedic Surgery, University of Western Ontario, London, Ontario, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Edward M. Vasarhelyi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Orthopaedic Surgery, University of Western Ontario, London, Ontario, Canada

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注临床成本和再入院率，与髋关节假体生物力学分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress/strain, micromotion, or include any finite element analysis or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同BMI患者全髋关节置换术后90天成本和再入院率
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析患者数据，按BMI分组比较
summary_zh.result: 高BMI组再入院率和成本显著增加
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床数据库的统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the association between body mass index and short-term costs and readmissions after primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective cohort analysis of patient records stratified by BMI categories.
summary_en.result: Higher BMI was associated with increased 90-day costs, reoperations, and readmissions.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of a large clinical database without biomechanical testing.

papers.title: Almond leaves for the one-pot Biofabrication of silver nanoparticles: Characterization and larvicidal application
papers.venue: International Journal of Scientific and Research Publications

llm.relevance_to_user: 此论文与AI生物打印研究方向完全无关，是关于银纳米颗粒的绿色合成和杀虫应用。
llm.why_not_core: No AI integration, no bioprinting workflow, no biomedical implant context, no experimental validation related to bioprinting or AI.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用杏仁叶绿色合成银纳米颗粒用于杀虫
summary_zh.method: 一锅法生物合成银纳米颗粒并进行表征
summary_zh.result: 成功合成具有杀虫活性的银纳米颗粒
summary_zh.validation: UV-Vis、FTIR等表征及杀蚊幼虫实验

summary_en.motivation: To develop an eco-friendly method for producing silver nanoparticles using almond leaves for larvicidal applications.
summary_en.method: One-pot biofabrication of silver nanoparticles with almond leaf extract, characterized by UV-Vis, FTIR, XRD, etc.
summary_en.result: The synthesized silver nanoparticles exhibited larvicidal activity against mosquito larvae.
summary_en.validation: Characterization via multiple spectroscopic and microscopic techniques and in vitro larvicidal assays.
